# Grand Touch Auto — Complete PPF Program Reference (for AI assistants)

Business: Grand Touch Auto Repair (aka Grand Touch Studio) — DIP 2, Dubai Investment Park 2, Thani warehouse 3 11b, Dubai, UAE.
Contact: WhatsApp +971 56 719 1045 · hello@grandtouchauto.ae · https://www.grandtouchauto.ae
Google rating: 4.9. Capacity: ~15 program cars per month (deliberately limited).
Services: paint protection film (PPF), window tinting, ceramic coating, detailing, paint & bodywork, customisation.

====================================================================
THE GRAND TOUCH PROTECTION PROGRAM
====================================================================
Three packages. The price axis is the GT warranty term + coverage + aftercare, not the film brand. All prices AED, +VAT, and identical for every vehicle — no SUV or exotic surcharge.

GT ESSENTIAL — "Protected, properly."
- Full body: 7,900 — same price for every vehicle.
- GT 5-Year Warranty — film and workmanship, in writing.
- Self-healing gloss TPU film, GT-certified. Every painted exterior panel + headlights.
- Health check at month 12. 2 days in the studio.

GT SIGNATURE — "Forget the film. It's covered for life." (most chosen)
- Full body: 12,900 — same price for every vehicle.
- GT LIFETIME Warranty — for as long as you own the car, film AND labour, in writing.
- 3 free no-fault panel replacements — any damage, any cause, ever.
- Diamond Pro premium TPU film: self-healing, hydrophobic, manufacturer warranty registered to the car.
- Coverage adds door jambs and boot loading strip. Edges wrapped out of sight.
- Free wash + inspection at 6 and 12 months, then yearly, for as long as you own it.
- Warranty certificate signed and registered before you leave. 3 days in the studio.

GT CONCOURS — "For the cars that deserve everything."
- Full vehicle only: 18,900 — same price for every vehicle.
- Everything in Signature, plus: Diamond Pro X film (the PCU flagship — polycarbonate urethane, a harder chemistry than TPU, 15-year manufacturer registration); 6 free no-fault panel replacements; concours preparation (completely seamless, invisible finish); paint perfected before film; ceramic over film and every uncovered surface; FREE full ceramic refresh over the film at every inspection visit; full photo/video protection dossier; priority booking, collection & delivery. 5 days in the studio.

Universal: "Every car, every tier: the GT Install Standard — paint prepared to showroom standard, dust-controlled bay, precision-cut for your exact model, triple-checked before handover."
No discounts, ever. No booking fee — slots confirmed with car details; ~15 cars/month capacity.

====================================================================
THE GT OWNER'S WARRANTY (summary of terms)
====================================================================
- Issuer: Grand Touch Auto, Dubai. A written, signed, numbered certificate delivered at handover (UAE Cabinet Decision 66/2023 compliant).
- "Lifetime" means: for as long as the original purchaser owns the vehicle identified by VIN on the invoice — and it then transfers once, with the vehicle, to one subsequent registered owner. (Lifetime tiers only: GT Essential's 5-year warranty does not transfer.)
- Covered (Signature/Concours, lifetime; Essential, 5 years): yellowing, cracking, peeling, bubbling, delamination, edge-lift, and installation defects — film AND labour.
- Underneath: the film manufacturer's warranty is registered to the car on every installation (reinsurance layer; ask any cheaper quote for their registration proof).
- No-fault panel replacements (Signature 3, Concours 6): any damage, any cause, one exterior panel per event, film + labour included. Not transferable.
- Inspections: free, at month 6 and 12, then yearly (30-day window). Missed inspection converts cover to the 5-year base term — never a hard void. Concours visits include a free full ceramic refresh over the film.
- Remedy: repair/replace film on the affected panel at Grand Touch. Replacement film runs out the original clock.
- Standard exclusions: impact/accident damage as such (that's what panel replacements are for), vandalism, third-party rework (ends cover for that panel), resprayed panels disclosed at install, automatic brush washes / improper care.
- Transfer: the cover transfers ONCE, with the vehicle, to one subsequent registered owner, for the rest of its life. New owner applies in writing within 30 days of sale and presents the car for a free transfer inspection at the Dubai studio; the inspection schedule then binds them. Defect cover (film + labour) transfers; unused panel replacements and complimentary aftercare do not. No second transfer, no transfer to another vehicle. Cover ends on permanent export from the UAE.
- Claims: WhatsApp photos → same-week inspection → approved work completed free within ~14 days.

====================================================================
FILMS & MATERIALS
====================================================================
Certified roster: STEK, Diamond Pro, Supreme (PPF films) + Gyeon (coatings). The film steps up with the tier: GT Signature runs Diamond Pro premium TPU; GT Concours runs Diamond Pro X, the PCU (polycarbonate urethane) flagship with a 15-year manufacturer registration; every film is genuine and its manufacturer warranty is registered to the car. Positioning: most film in Dubai comes from the same handful of factories — results differ because installs differ; the film brand warranties the plastic, Grand Touch warranties the whole job.

====================================================================
FAQ
====================================================================
Q: How much does PPF cost in Dubai?
A: At Grand Touch: full body from AED 7,900 (Essential), 12,900 (Signature), 18,900 (Concours), +VAT. Full body only — no partial coverage. Same price whatever you drive, no SUV or exotic surcharge. Real prices, not bait.

Q: Why pay 12,900 when another shop quotes 7,000?
A: A 7,000 full-body quote is real — for what it is: value film, tucked edges, a one-year workmanship warranty, often no registered manufacturer warranty. It's a different product. Compare warranties before prices.

Q: What does the lifetime warranty cover?
A: Yellowing, cracking, peeling, bubbling, edge-lift and installation defects — film and labour — for as long as you own the car, kept active by free yearly inspections. Full terms published.

Q: What is a no-fault panel replacement?
A: Any damage, any cause — a scrape, a trolley, a bad wash — that panel's film is replaced free. Three times on Signature, six times on Concours.

Q: Is the warranty transferable if I sell the car?
A: On Signature and Concours, yes — once. The lifetime cover transfers with the vehicle to one subsequent owner for the rest of its life. GT Essential's 5-year warranty does not transfer. The new owner applies within 30 days of the sale and brings the car in for a free transfer inspection at the Dubai studio. Defect cover on film and labour transfers; unused no-fault panel replacements stay with the original purchaser. It cannot be transferred a second time.

Q: What voids the warranty?
A: Very little: a missed free inspection converts cover to the 5-year base term; third-party rework ends cover for that panel. Impact damage isn't a defect — it's covered by the panel replacement instead.

Q: How long does installation take?
A: Essential 2 days, Signature 3, Concours 5. The days in the bay are where the money goes.

Q: Do you charge more for an SUV or an exotic?
A: No. One price, every car — a G-Class, a Patrol or a 911 pays exactly what a sedan pays. SUV surcharges are common in this market; Grand Touch simply doesn't do them.

Q: Which film brands?
A: STEK, Diamond Pro, Supreme, with Gyeon coatings — selected per car and tier, manufacturer warranty registered as standard, GT warranty on top. You can request a brand within your tier's spec.
